newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel SA downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel SA downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it has downgraded shares of Brazilian state-owned Copel power firm to hold from buy.
-- The brokerage cited what it termed as the company's disappointing third-quarter result. It added the firm is currently fully valued by the market.
-- The company, which is owned by Parana state, posted a third-quarter net income of 39.7 million reais, compared with Credit Lyonnais projection for a 49.4 million real net profit, it said.
-- Preferred shares of Copel, known formally as Companhia Paranaense de Energia, have risen some 57 percent year-to-date, Credit Lyonnais said.
-- Moreover, the state of Parana, which owns the company, does not plan to privatize the company, the brokerage said.
-- "We see this as a disadvantage to the company as competition intensifies in the future," it said.
-- Despite the lower-than-expected third-quarter result, Credit Lyonnais is maintaining its year-end earnings forecasts for Copel.
-- Copel preferred ended flat at 8.00 reais while its voting common fell 0.10 reais to 10.45 reais Wednesday on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
